Business rules theo wiki hotel booking RULE:
BR-01: A booking is confirmed only after the payment succeeds.
BR-02: The selected room is held for the guest during checkout; the hold is released when it expires.
BR-03: Free cancellation is allowed until the cancellation deadline of the rate plan.
BR-04: The number of guests cannot exceed the room capacity.
BR-05: The guest must verify the phone number with an OTP before paying.
Thời gian giữ phòng bao lâu thì mình chưa chốt, để thành open question không critical. Xác nhận 5 BR như trên, chuyển sang Workflow.
